evidence.quoted_text: exec(compile(data, str(path), "exec"), module.__dict__)  # noqa: S102 - bound bytes
evidence.reason: Line 82 compiles the helper bytes without guarding SyntaxError; _load_helper translates only OSError into Refused, unlike the live-binding loader at lines 114-118. A malformed readable helper therefore raises SyntaxError out of the helper-load boundary instead of the controlled Refused path. Under current contract item 2, an error with no result in --json mode must write its { error: … } object to stdout and leave stderr empty, so an unhandled compile failure violates the machine-mode output contract. Smallest fix: catch SyntaxError around compile/exec and raise Refused, keeping the hash check and executing only the hashed bytes.
